SELECT r.*, f.name org_name, count( DISTINCT d.investigator_case_id ) caseCount, ROUND(( r.total_money / IF ( count( DISTINCT d.investigator_case_id )= 0, 1, count( DISTINCT d.investigator_case_id ))), 2 ) avgMoney, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT u.id ) clockIds FROM survey_pre_reimbursement r LEFT JOIN survey_franchisee f ON r.survey_org_id = f.id LEFT JOIN investigator_pre_details d ON r.id = d.investigator_re_id LEFT JOIN survey_user_clock u ON r.survey_user_id = u.survey_user_id AND r.survey_org_id = u.survey_org_id LEFT JOIN survey_clock_case c ON u.id = c.clock_id WHERE d.id IS NOT NULL AND c.id IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT( r.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( u.clock_time, '%Y-%m' )
AND FIND_IN_SET(r.survey_org_id,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(id) FROM survey_franchisee WHERE id = #{orgId} or parent_id = #{orgId}))
and (r.state = 2 or r.state = 3)
and r.state = #{preState}
AND FIND_IN_SET( r.survey_org_id, #{surveyOrgIds} )
and FIND_IN_SET(r.survey_user_id,#{investigators})
GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id DESC
limit #{pageIndex}, #{pageSize}

SELECT b.*,ROUND(SUM(b.file_money+ b.night_money + b.traffic_money + b.mileage_money + b.cityin_driving_money),2)total_money FROM (SELECT u.survey_user_id surveyUserId,u.survey_user_name surveyUserName,SUM(IFNULL( i.medical_history_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.troubleshooting_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.opc_troubleshooting_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.printing_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.other_money, 0 )) file_money,SUM(IFNULL( i.accommodatio_money, 0 )) night_money, SUM(IFNULL( i.cross_driving_money, 0) ) traffic_money, SUM(IFNULL( i.self_driving_money, 0 )+IFNULL( i.toll_money, 0 )) mileage_money, SUM(IFNULL( i.cityin_driving_money, 0 )) cityin_driving_money FROM survey_user_clock u LEFT JOIN survey_clock_re_info i ON u.id = i.clock_id WHERE u.survey_user_id = #{param1} and u.survey_org_id = #{param2} AND DATE_FORMAT( u.clock_time, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m')) b

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(re_total_money),0),2) helpMoney FROM survey_clock_case WHERE entrust_type = 1 AND FIND_IN_SET(clock_id,#{clockIds}) ) a, (SELECT ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(re_total_money),0),2) insMoney FROM survey_clock_case WHERE entrust_type = 2 AND FIND_IN_SET(clock_id,#{clockIds})) b
SELECT * FROM survey_pre_reimbursement WHERE survey_user_id = #{userId} and survey_org_id = #{surveyOrgId} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m') = #{preInfoDate} limit 1;

SELECT SUM( cityin_driving_money ) cityinDrivingMoney, SUM( medical_history_money ) medicalHistoryMoney, SUM( troubleshooting_money ) troubleshootingMoney, SUM( opc_troubleshooting_money ) opcTroubleshootingMoney, SUM( printing_money ) printingMoney, SUM( accommodatio_money ) accommodatioMoney, SUM( cross_driving_money ) crossDrivingMoney, SUM( self_driving_money + toll_money ) selfDrivingMoney, SUM( other_money ) otherMoney FROM survey_clock_case WHERE FIND_IN_SET(clock_id,#{clockIds})
SELECT survey_user_id userId,survey_org_id orgId FROM survey_user_clock WHERE survey_user_id = #{param1} AND DATE_FORMAT( clock_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{param2} GROUP BY survey_org_id

UPDATE survey_pre_reimbursement r LEFT JOIN (SELECT #{id} id, SUM(IFNULL( i.medical_history_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.troubleshooting_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.printing_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.other_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.opc_troubleshooting_money, 0 )) file_money, SUM(IFNULL( i.accommodatio_money, 0 )) night_money, SUM(IFNULL( i.cross_driving_money, 0) ) traffic_money, SUM(IFNULL( i.self_driving_money, 0 )+IFNULL( i.toll_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.cityin_driving_money, 0 )) mileage_money, SUM(IFNULL( i.medical_history_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.troubleshooting_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.printing_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.other_money, 0 )+IFNULL( i.cityin_driving_money, 0 )+IFNULL( i.accommodatio_money, 0 )+IFNULL( i.cross_driving_money, 0)+IFNULL( i.self_driving_money, 0 )+IFNULL( i.toll_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.opc_troubleshooting_money, 0 )) total_money FROM survey_user_clock u LEFT JOIN survey_clock_re_info i ON u.id = i.clock_id WHERE u.survey_user_id = #{userId} AND u.survey_org_id = #{orgId} AND DATE_FORMAT( u.clock_time, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT((SELECT create_time FROM survey_pre_reimbursement WHERE id = #{id}),'%Y-%m') ) b ON r.id = b.id SET r.file_money = b.file_money,r.night_money = b.night_money,r.traffic_money =b.traffic_money,r.mileage_money = b.mileage_money,r.total_money=b.total_money WHERE r.id = #{id}
